description.value: Blind Rabbit is a neighbourhood bar and charcuterie restaurant on East Hastings Street in Vancouver's Hastings-Sunrise area, specializing in an extensive lineup of BC craft gins and spirits alongside boards, paninis, and fondue. The venue is fully wheelchair accessible, including accessible washrooms. Its food-forward bar menu makes it a potential refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the east side of the city.
